The Perfect Voxel Engine - John Lin's Thoughts
The perfect voxel engine should provide the tools with which to build bigger infrastructures on top of, which is where the game engine starts coming into play. In the next post, we'll (hopefully for real) dive into the rendering architecture. It'll be all about Vulkan, which I can't wait to talk about!
